name: Follies of the Heart
source:
Tomorrow is the day the princess is set to die. Sacrificed to “The Endless King” for ten more years free of its relentless hunger. She’d made peace with this fate, and yet fate challenges her still. Her favorite companion, the ever whimsical Jester, visits her on this very night, offering up a most ridiculous proposal:

“Silly little princess, you are for certain the most foolish person I have ever had the pleasure of meeting….. Run away with me.”

[From [url=https://d3adxfish.itch.io/follies-of-the-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
明天就是公主的死期了。牺牲给“无尽之王”十年，使其不再遭受无情的饥饿。她已经接受了这种命运，但命运仍然挑战着她。她最喜欢的伙伴，总是异想天开的小丑，就在这个晚上来看望她，提出了一个最荒谬的求婚：

“傻小公主，你真是我有幸见过的最傻的人了……跟我走吧。”

[来自[url=https://d3adxfish.itch.io/follies-of-the-heart]itch.io[/url]]
